name: kyfes
description: Know Your Frontend: secure, predictable frontends for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: kyfes
plugins.description: Enforces frontend best practices for React, Next.js, Vue, Angular and SvelteKit: cookie-based HttpOnly sessions (BFF), CSRF, CSP and XSS guards, one HTTP client, TanStack Query, CASL RBAC on CRUD, i18n, charts, a fixed src/ layout, guardrail hooks and planner/implementer/reviewer agents.
